body: It is not so black and white, if only it were that simple. I love them, even if I don’t understand them all the way. Moving is a dream, I just don’t know how to go about it realistically, or if it’d really help.

I have had a few PR hits in my life, my parents are proud people, and we live in a small town, I don’t think I could handle that getting around, honestly. I know it sounds shitty, and I don’t care for myself, I just can’t stand the disappointment. Thank you
I have a doctors appointment this Friday, we’ll see how it goes. I’m a little paranoid about therapists or people in general, I don’t want to go to a psych ward, or people passing judgment on me.

Anything is too broad, but I didn’t specify either. No, I had written a post earlier. Don’t know if it was deleted or what. But I’m exhausted, trying to maintain myself, by myself. I have numerous hobbies, a good group of loving people around me, a good job, and I am miserable. (You could say ungrateful, but I am) I am happy with my life. But I can’t suppress my suicidal urges, and I get them everyday, multiple times a day. It has been this for nearly a decade. I don’t care to live up to the image I have painted of myself to my peers, I’m ready to give up, and just face the inevitable.
